fixed: Searching for a figure by another of its names, such as "do si do", "docey doe" or "right and left thru", now also finds lines you typed in those words, in a dance of any form, as well as every figure of that call. Searching "balance in the ring" finds a square's balance in the ring.
changed: A square's right and left through with a full courtesy turn now says "with a full turn" in its figure line, so it no longer reads like a plain one, and you can search for it by those words.

fixed: FilterCompiler matches each free-text word also with no move name or keyword rewritten (its role words still canonical), and DanceRepository.searchText matches the query's role-canonical words too, so a move keyword no longer hides text typed in its words.
changed: Square taxonomy v1 (unreleased, amended): sq_right_left_through's renderTemplate gains {fullTurn}, which FigureRenderer writes as "with a full turn" in display and canonical text.
